about_the_game:
Inspired by a classic family card game played by millions worldwide, moves are now animated with modern manga in Dodgeball Dojo!

Features:

• Big 2 / Pusoy Dos - Easy and fun card shedding game family pastime

• Play Together - Real time competition against players globally with inspiration from Big 2 and poker rules

• Dodgeball - Winning card hands come to life with 3D chibi and 2D anime dodge and throws

• Energy / Fatigue - Harness Energy (Qi or the Force) with card play control and speed

• Wild Cards - Transform Energy for creative comebacks and strategic wins

• Athlete Ability - Throw wild gameplay twists by forming Bombs with card combos

• Pet Power - Discover unique round advantages activated by Spirit Pet elements

• Private Party - Host tournaments and play with family and friends on your own rules

• Emote - Level up to collect 3D dances and 2D emojis to troll your friends in real time

• Martial Arts - Discover choreography and cultures around the world, from kung fu to krav maga

• Spirit Pets - Get lucky and win animals from around the world

• Anime - Blends art styles of Japanese manga with American comic strips

• World Tour - Unlock your favorite Stadium and get home court advantage

• Events - Exciting challenges give free rewards

• Win Big - Climb leaderboards and score prizes at Black Belt and above

Big 2, known by many names worldwide, is an East meets West universally beloved family game; also known as President in Europe, 大老二/斗地主 in China , 锄大弟 in Hong Kong, Pusoy Dos in Philippines, Daifugō(大富豪) in Japan, Tiến Lên in Vietnam, and Capsa in Indonesia.

Follow us @DodgeballDojo on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, and YouTube!

PLEASE NOTE! Dodgeball Dojo® is free to download and play, but some game items can be purchased with real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

A persistent network connection is also required to play (network fees may apply).

Privacy Policy:

Terms of Service:

Last but not least, thank you to our family and friends who supported us as we worked those long hours.
